pitch: Fuel the steam locomotive across phonetic bridges by matching vowel team 'ai' words (/eɪ/) and author's purpose signals.
targetFormula: The rain on the train made the snail wait on the main trail.
topic: Vowel team 'ai' (/eɪ/): rain, train, mail, tail, nail, sail, paint, wait, main, chain; contrast with short a; author's purpose

arc.discovery: Phase 1: Steam Gauge Radar scans train stations for cargo boxes marked with vowel team 'ai'.
arc.workbench: Phase 2: Track Switching Workbench requires teams to sort minimal pairs (ran vs rain, pan vs pain) and fix railway signals.
arc.karaoke: Phase 3: The Train Conductor Teleprompter prompts team drivers to announce station arrivals with rich long-a vowel clarity.

mechanics: High-energy train navigation arcade on the smartboard. Correct vowel choices pump steam into the boiler (+5 XP). Confusing short /æ/ and long /eɪ/ makes the train whistle blow a soft steam puff with a helpful vowel hint.

softFail: Listen closely! Is it short /æ/ like 'pan' or long /eɪ/ like 'pain'? 👂
Remember: 'A' and 'I' together say the long A sound! 🅰️
Look at the spelling: does it have 'ai' in the middle? 🔎
Keep the sound long and smooth like a train whistle! 🎶
feedback.levelUp: Golden Express Engine unlocked! Level Up to Chief Railway Engineer! 🚂👑

smartboard.boardActions: Team conductors pull interactive whistle cords, flip track switches, and load cargo crates labeled with 'ai'.
smartboard.classParticipation: Desks pull imaginary train whistles 'Choo-choo!' and make long /eɪ/ gestures when a target word appears.
smartboard.version15min: 10 rounds focusing on minimal pair recognition and word building.
smartboard.version30min: Full 30-round championship including author's purpose classification, listening discernment, and live announcements.
